sentences.text:
Smt. Kamlesh Gupta vs Distt. Magistrate , Lko. And Others on 13
May, 2024
Author: Sangeeta Chandra

Bench: Sangeeta Chandra
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc-Lko:36526-Db
Court No. - 3
Case :- Writ - C No. - 4145 of 2024
Petitioner :- Smt. Kamlesh Gupta

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Respondent :- Distt. Magistrate , Lko. And Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Shakti Kumar Sharma,Jatin Raheja,Shobhit Harsh

Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Mrs. Sangeeta Chandra,J.
Hon'ble Brij Raj Singh,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Standing Counsel appearing on behalf of the State Respondents.

2. This petition has been filed with the following main prayer:-
"[a] Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus commanding the opposite parties to decide the representation dated 30/03/2024 sent by the petitioner to the opposite parties, within stipulated time period/ expeditiously."
3. It is the case of the petitioner that she had purchased certain land from its recorded tenure holder Smt. Kamlesh Gupta vs Distt. Magistrate , Lko.

entities.text: Kamlesh Gupta vs Distt. Magistrate , Lko
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: And Others on 13 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/31849574/
and she is entitled to the compensation.
She has made detailed representation in this regard to the Additional District Magistrate (Land Acquisition)/ Competent Authority under National Highways Act on 30.03.2024, which is pending.

entities.text: Additional District Magistrate (Land Acquisition)/ Competent Authority
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 4. Learned Standing Counsel, on the basis of instructions dated 08.05.2024 received from the Additional District Magistrate (Land Acquisition), Lucknow, has pointed that the land in question was notified under Section 3A of the National Highways Act on 22.03.2012 and Section 3D notification was issued on 07.03.2013.

The petitioner has purchased the land after it vested in the Central Government on 13.08.2015, and, therefore the petitioner is not entitled to any compensation as she had bought the land after its vesting in the Central Government.

5. In view of such instructions, learned Standing Counsel has placed reliance upon a Full Bench decision of this Court in Sursati Vs. State of U.P. and others; decided on 05.09.2022, reported in 2022 (9) ADJ 547, wherein question no.1 related to same facts as have been mentioned by the petitioner in her representation.

entities.text: Sursati Vs. State of U.P. and others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
6. This petition is disposed of with a direction to the Competent Authority under the National Highways Act to decide the representation of the petitioner in light of the judgement rendered by Full Bench of this Court in Sursati Vs. State of U.P. and others, within a period of eight weeks from the date a certified copy of this order is produced before him.
Order Date :- 13.5.2024
